newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices slide, crop arrivals seen up.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices slide, crop arrivals seen up.

text.p: Indian castorseed December delivery prices on Wednesday slid to 1,086/1,087 rupees from 1,093/1,094 on fresh speculative offerings, dealers said.
"Sluggish export demand and expectation of higher new crop arrivals in the coming days triggered bull liquidation," one dealer said.
The markets were closed on Monday and Tuesday for local festivals. Dealers said more castor was expected in the market.
Groundnut oil fell from 361/362 rupees to 356/357 rupees per 10 kg as festival demand eased. Stockists were booking profits on expectation of higher new crop arrivals next week.
